#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using i64 = long long;

constexpr int MOD = 1000000007;

struct mint {
    int x;
    mint(int v = 0) : x(v % MOD) { if (x < 0) x += MOD; }
    int val() const { return x; }
};

mint operator+(const mint& a, const mint& b) {
    int s = a.x + b.x;
    return s >= MOD ? s - MOD : s;
}

mint operator-(const mint& a, const mint& b) {
    int d = a.x - b.x;
    return d < 0 ? d + MOD : d;
}

mint operator*(const mint& a, const mint& b) {
    return static_cast<i64>(a.x) * b.x % MOD;
}

mint mod_pow(mint base, int exp) {
    mint result = 1;
    while (exp) {
        if (exp & 1) result = result * base;
        base = base * base;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

const int MOD_ALT = 998244353;
const int BASE = 1000000;
const int K = 6;

i64 N_val;
i64 pos_counter;
int suffix_count = 0;
mint sum_table[K + 1];
vector<int> suffix_lists[K + 1];

void precompute_dfs(int level, i64 num) {
    int current_val = ((pos_counter++ - num) % MOD_ALT + MOD_ALT) % MOD_ALT;
    sum_table[level] = sum_table[level] + current_val;
    suffix_lists[level].push_back(current_val);
    if (level == K) return;
    for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; ++digit) {
        precompute_dfs(level + 1, num * 10 + digit);
    }
}

void query_dfs(i64 num) {
    if (num >= N_val) return;
    if ((num + 1) * BASE <= N_val && num * BASE * 10 >= N_val) {
        i64 power = 1;
        for (int level = 0; level <= K; ++level) {
            int list_size = suffix_lists[level].size();
            int offset = ((pos_counter - power * num) % MOD_ALT + MOD_ALT) % MOD_ALT;
            int comp_val = (MOD_ALT - offset) % MOD_ALT;
            int match_count = lower_bound(suffix_lists[level].begin(), suffix_lists[level].end(), comp_val) - suffix_lists[level].begin();
            mint contribution = list_size * offset + sum_table[level] - (list_size - match_count) * MOD_ALT;
            sum_table[K + 1] = sum_table[K + 1] + contribution;
            power *= 10;
        }
        pos_counter += suffix_count;
        return;
    }
    int term = ((pos_counter++ - num) % MOD_ALT + MOD_ALT) % MOD_ALT;
    sum_table[K + 1] = sum_table[K + 1] + term;
    for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; ++digit) {
        query_dfs(num * 10 + digit);
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> N_val;
    N_val += 1;
    precompute_dfs(0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i <= K; ++i) {
        suffix_count += static_cast<int>(suffix_lists[i].size());
        sort(suffix_lists[i].begin(), suffix_lists[i].end());
    }
    pos_counter = 1;
    for (int d = 1; d < 10; ++d) {
        query_dfs(d);
    }
    cout << sum_table[K + 1].val() << '\n';
    return 0;
}

    Mint r = 1;
    for (; e; e /= 2, b = b * b) if (e & 1) r = r * b;
    return r;

const int M2 = 998244353;
const int P = 1000000;
const int LIMIT = 6;

ll n;
ll idx;
int suf_cnt;
Mint prefix_sum[LIMIT + 2];
vector<int> suffixes[LIMIT + 2];

    int val = ((idx++ - num) % M2 + M2) % M2;
    prefix_sum[level] = prefix_sum[level] + val;
    suffixes[level].push_back(val);

    for (int d = 0; d < 10; ++d) {

    }

void solve_dfs(ll num) {
    if (num >= n) return;
    if ((num + 1) * P <= n && num * P * 10 >= n) {
        ll factor = 1;
        for (int lv = 0; lv <= LIMIT; ++lv) {
            int sz = suffixes[lv].size();
            int offset = ((idx - factor * num) % M2 + M2) % M2;

        return;

    prefix_sum[LIMIT + 1] = prefix_sum[LIMIT + 1] + Mint(((idx++ - num) % M2 + M2) % M2);
    for (int d = 0; d < 10; ++d) {
